announced on Wednesday that it sold its remaining shares in ZTO Express
, ending its status as a beneficial owner of more than 5% of the company.
Alibaba's investment units sold a total of 25M Class A shares at $19.28 per ADS.
The sale involved three Alibaba units: Alibaba ZT Investment, New Retail Strategic Opportunities Investments 2, and Cainiao Smart Logistics Investment.
Following the sale, Alibaba's stake in ZTO fell to 21.94M shares, or 2.9%.

title: Alibaba sells 25M ZTO shares, cutting the stake to 2.9%
